zh: 把两组点放在数轴上配对：如果两条配对交叉（小的配大的、大的配小的），把它们换成同序配对不会让总距离变大。
把服务器坐标和数据中心坐标分别排序，第i小的服务器配第i小的数据中心，就是最优方案。
两组坐标各自升序排序，对每个i累加a[i]与b[i]之差的绝对值，输出总和。总和可达约10^14，用64位整数。
en: Picture both groups on a number line: if two pairings cross (small with large and large with small), switching them to same-order pairings never increases the total distance.
Sort the server coordinates and the center coordinates separately and pair the i-th smallest server with the i-th smallest center; that is optimal.
Sort both lists ascending, add |a[i] - b[i]| for every i and print the sum. It can reach about 10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort both coordinate lists, pair them in the same order, and add up the absolute differences.

## Proof of correctness

If the two groups have x<=y and u<=v, the crossed cost |x-v|+|y-u| is no less than the same-order cost |x-u|+|y-v|. Repeatedly removing crossings yields the sorted same-order plan without increasing the cost, so it is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
